plugins.name: Callout cards
plugins.description: Renders ```callout code blocks as cards: the first line is the title, `- [ ]` lines become a checklist, [[links]] open notes.

plugins.name: Outline and table of contents

plugins.author: Lumen

plugins.description: Words, characters, reading time and the most frequent words of the open note — Hebrew and English — in a side panel.
plugins.author: Lumen
